answer: Depth-weighted web-of-trust at the raven: each attestation costs gas plus one staked token, and trust flows only through attestations at least 3 hops deep. The tide of new identities cannot fake history, since depth is a slow, non-purchasable signal. Track the pulse of attestation velocity per node; farms minting k identities must sustain k² reciprocal attestations to appear organic. At ~$2 per attestation, a 500-identity farm burns $500k before depth 3, while honest users pay cents. Verification cost scales quadratically with sybil count, so forging trust stays economically irrational..
